description: Keyword search over model and dataset records, with task, license, size and format filters, when you have no exact name; returns ids and short summaries. Use when you need keyword or filtered catalog results without an exact model name. Example: {"q":"embedding","limit":5}. Reads records; does not change files. Default answer is concise (at most 2800 bytes); use detail=full for the full record.

commercial.description: True to require recorded permission for commercial use.

cursor.description: Page cursor returned by the previous read.

detail.description: Concise by default; full returns the extended record and evidence.

explain.description: Set to true to include why each row matched.

format.description: File format to filter by, such as gguf or safetensors.

framework.description: Library or framework to filter by, such as transformers or llama.cpp.

hosting.description: Hosting state to filter by, such as hosted for files Hugging Bay serves.

license.description: License label to filter by, such as apache-2.0 or mit.

limit.description: Maximum number of returned rows; use the stated bounds.

q.description: Text to search for, such as qwen coder 7b or an owner/repo.

reviewStatus.description: Review level to filter by, from the allowed values.

semantic.description: Set to true to rank by meaning instead of keywords.

sort.description: Result order, from the allowed values; best is the default ranking.

task.description: Exact catalog task label, or code, chat, pictures. For a broad capability such as reranking, use q without task; an exact task filter can exclude matches.

type.description: Artifact type to filter by, such as llm, embedding or dataset.

name: search_artifacts

availabilityWord.description: Where this row stands, in one of five words. Display only; never download permission.

catalogDescription.description: Recorded-use sentence when catalog descriptions are enabled; no execution or quality promise.

defaultDownloadBytes.description: Selected download bytes, or null when unrecorded. Never a repository total.

repoBytes.description: Total repository bytes across files and variants.

noteMessage.description: Original route note, when a public qualification occupies note.

anyOf.description: Full details when detail is full, or a separate service handoff.

title: Search the catalog
